verses.text: Hear this word that YHWH has spoken against you⁺, O sons of Israel, against all the family that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:

verses.text: “Only you⁺ have I known from all of the families of the earth; upon thus I will visit punishment on you⁺ [for] all your⁺ iniquities.”

verses.text: Does a lion roar in the forest and no prey [is] unto him? Does a young lion give forth his voice from his den, unless he has captured?

verses.text: A lion has roared—who will not fear? The Lord YHWH has spoken—who will not prophesy?
